newsitem.title: USA: US advisory group protests air ticket tax ideas.
newsitem.headline: US advisory group protests air ticket tax ideas.

text.p: An advisory group established by Congress on Wednesday complained that increased taxes on air travellers would not go to improving air safety.
The National Civial Aviation Review Commission said steps taken by Congressional tax writing committees over the past two weeks would divert the extra money to other programs.

"...the revenues from this consumer tax increase will not be available to invest in additional modernization of the air traffic, navigation and communication systems," the commission said in a statement.
"Without this investment, passenger delays will grow very rapidly and the safety of the system will be diminished."
House and Senate tax panels have made proposals that would increase ticket taxes on international travel.

The commission was established last year by Congress to make recommendations on how best to finance and reform the budgeting of U.S. aviation programs. It expects to make its recommendations in about a month.
